submission.justification: Mixture-G2 with a 2.0 mm gas gap achieves the best time resolution of 0.891 ns among all tested configurations. This represents approximately a 36% improvement over Mixture-G1 (1.21 ns) and a 110% improvement over Mixture-G3 (1.874 ns) at the same gap. The simulation tested all three candidate mixtures across the full allowed gap range (1-3 mm), and Mixture-G2 at 2.0 mm consistently outperformed all other combinations. While Mixture-G2 is a standard fluorinated mixture, the planned 90% recovery closed-loop recirculation system significantly mitigates environmental impact. No explicit policy documents were found prohibiting fluorinated gases, and the HV system (up to 12 kV) is compatible with all mixtures. The 2.0 mm gap also matches the gap used in the 2025 simulation baseline, providing consistency with previous studies.
